entity.name: Archer Midnight — UAE Launch Edition Flight Test Campaign
entity.meta_description: Archer Aviation's Midnight eVTOL completed in-country UAE flight test campaign culminating 14 November 2025. Full-envelope desert testing as part of the Launch Edition program with Abu Dhabi Aviation.
